standard_prerequisites.name: The limit presentation X = lim X_i with affine transition morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the identification of the category of constructible sheaves on X as the colimit of those on the X_i, which the present lemma sharpens to locally constant sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies full faithfulness and the form of the remaining question, namely that a constructible sheaf becoming finite locally constant on X already does so at some stage.

standard_prerequisites.name: Approximation of an etale covering of the limit
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma allowing an etale covering of X with affine members to be approximated by an etale covering of some X_{i'}
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the passage from the covering U of X trivialising F to a covering U_{i'} of X_{i'} with the same index set.

core_obligations: Reduce to the essential surjectivity statement (proof lines 12652-12658): full faithfulness in each of the three cases is the colimit lemma for constructible sheaves, so it remains to show that a constructible F_i on X_i whose pullback F to X is finite locally constant becomes finite locally constant at some stage i' >= i.

Use the trivialising covering (proof lines 12659-12665): choose an etale covering U = {U_j -> X} with F|U_j isomorphic to a constant sheaf underline S_j for a finite set S_j; one may take the U_j affine and, X being quasi-compact, the index set J finite.

Approximate the covering (proof lines 12666-12672): the affine-sites colimit lemma gives i' >= i and an etale covering U_{i'} = {U_{i',j} -> X_{i'}} whose base change to X is U; the sheaves F_{i'}|U_{i',j} and underline S_j become isomorphic after increasing i', since their pullbacks to U_j are isomorphic and both are constructible; hence F_{i'} is finite locally constant, and the proof for abelian sheaves and for finite type Lambda-modules is exactly the same.
proof_roadmap: Get full faithfulness from the colimit lemma for constructible sheaves, reducing to essential surjectivity.
Trivialise the pullback on a finite affine etale covering of X and approximate that covering by one on some X_{i'}.
Spread the trivialisation to the approximant, so the pullback of F_i to X_{i'} is finite locally constant.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies finite locally constant sheaves (of sets, of abelian groups, and of finite type Lambda-modules) on a limit of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with the colimit of the corresponding categories on the approximants (statement lines 12631-12649). The proof (proof lines 12651-12672) reduces to essential surjectivity, trivialises the pullback on a finite affine etale covering of X, approximates that covering at some stage by the affine-sites colimit lemma, and spreads the trivialisation to the approximant; the abelian and Lambda-module cases are identical. H2: one reduction and one spreading argument, written out.
